title: the same manifest with $schema added but the inline fields left in place
rationale: The issue notes that adding $schema is necessary but not sufficient: the power then loads with all functional components excluded. The manifest now passes, the three inline fields are reported and ignored, and the skill loads from skills/ because that is where it happens to be. A client that reads the inline skills array would load it twice or from the wrong path.
quote: Clients MUST NOT assign semantics to unknown fields.
